description: Get the full Codenation record of one tool by its slug (as returned by search_tools): description, makers, category, tags, pricing model, website, the collections it belongs to, and when available a checked presentation with what it does, who it suits, the price read on the tool's own pricing page, the date it was read and the source URL. Returns an error result if the slug is unknown.
name: get_tool
title: Get a tool
